vulnerabilities.title: STRIPTLS Active Downgrade MitM Attack
vulnerabilities.description: Session #1: Inline network tampering detected on port 587. Adversary stripped '250-STARTTLS' from ESMTP capabilities. Client proceeded with plaintext AUTH LOGIN, leaking credentials.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Deploy MTA-STS (RFC 8461) and enforce TLS-required policy on submission port 587.

vulnerabilities.title: Plaintext Credential Wire Leakage
vulnerabilities.description: Administrative credentials transmitted without transport encryption (Base64 admin@gov.in visible in raw wire payload).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Terminate cleartext authentication handlers and enforce strict SMTPS (Port 465).

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated TLS 1.0 with 3DES Cipher (Sweet32 / BEAST)
vulnerabilities.description: Session #1: TLS 1.0 with TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA. Subject to 64-bit block collision attacks (CVE-2016-2183) and BEAST (CVE-2011-3389).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Deprecate TLS 1.0/1.1; enable TLS 1.2+ with AES-GCM suites.

vulnerabilities.remediation: Re-issue certificate under valid CA with minimum RSA 2048-bit or ECDSA P-256.

vulnerabilities.title: STRIPTLS Downgrade Attack Detected
vulnerabilities.description: Session #3: cleartext SMTP on port 587 without STARTTLS negotiation. Plaintext credentials transmitted, consistent with active inline STRIPTLS MitM attack.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Deploy MTA-STS (RFC 8461) and DANE/TLSA DNS records. Reject plaintext fallback on submission ports.

vulnerabilities.title: Expired Self-Signed Certificate (1024-bit RSA)
vulnerabilities.description: Session #2: self-signed certificate expired 637 days ago, SHA-1 signature, 1024-bit RSA key vulnerable to offline factoring.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Replace with CA-signed certificate using SHA-256 and minimum 2048-bit RSA key.

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated TLS 1.0 with 3DES Cipher
vulnerabilities.description: Session #2: TLS 1.0 with TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA. Vulnerable to BEAST (CVE-2011-3389) and Sweet32 (CVE-2016-2183).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to TLS 1.2+ with AES-GCM cipher suites. Disable TLS 1.0 and 3DES.

vulnerabilities.title: No Forward Secrecy (Static RSA Key Exchange)
vulnerabilities.description: Session #2: static RSA key exchange. Historical sessions decryptable if server private key is compromised.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure server to prefer ECDHE key exchange. Disable static RSA cipher suites.
